toolLabels.does_schedule_task: Sets up a task to run later or on a repeating schedule.
toolLabels.does_create_workflow: Creates a new workflow in this workspace.
toolLabels.does_data_table_query: Reads rows from one of this workspace's data tables.
toolLabels.does_data_table_write: Adds or changes rows in one of this workspace's data tables.
toolLabels.does_coding_task: Starts a coding task that can read and change files in a code workspace.
toolLabels.does_delegate_to_specialist: Hands part of the task to another agent and reads its answer.
toolLabels.does_delegate_parallel: Hands parts of the task to several agents and reads their answers.
toolLabels.label_web_task: Use a browser on a website
toolLabels.does_web_task: Opens a browser that reads pages and can click and type on the sites it visits.
toolLabels.label_local_desktop_activate: Bring an app to the front
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_activate: Brings the named application to the foreground on this computer.
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_click: Clicks a point or element on your screen.
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_clipboard: Reads from or writes to the clipboard on this computer.
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_elements: Lists the buttons and fields currently on screen (read-only).
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_key: Presses a key or a key combination (for example Cmd+S) on this computer.
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_notify: Shows a notification on this computer.
toolLabels.label_local_desktop_open: Open an app, file, or link
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_open: Opens an application, a file, or a web link on this computer.
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_press: Presses a named button or menu on your screen.
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_screen: Captures what is currently on your screen (read-only).
toolLabels.does_local_desktop_type: Types text into the app currently in the foreground.
toolLabels.does_run_desktop_recipe: Replays a recorded run of desktop actions on this computer.

localModelWizard.firstRunServingBody: Agents on this install already answer with {tag} for free, no API key. Add a cloud provider key if you ever need a bigger or different model.

browserAutomation.watchEmpty: No replay of this recipe is in the log yet. One appears here as soon as the agent runs it.

desktopAutomation.title: Desktop automation
desktopAutomation.subtitle: Replay a recorded desktop task - opening apps, clicking, typing - without asking the AI at every step.
desktopAutomation.loadFailed: Couldn't load desktop automation. Reload the page to try again.
desktopAutomation.recipesHelp: A desktop recipe replays a successful run step by step on this machine, checking each step, and stops as soon as something differs. Recipes keep placeholders only - never the values you typed.
desktopAutomation.recipesEmpty: No desktop recipes for this agent yet. After a run that drove the desktop in the playground, choose "Save this run as a desktop recipe".
desktopAutomation.modeAutoHint: Runs every step at full speed; the live monitor still shows what happened afterwards.
desktopAutomation.modeMonitorHint: Shows the desktop live while the steps run - use this the first few times you trust a recipe.
desktopAutomation.confirmIrreversible: This recipe contains steps that commit or submit something. I approve running them.
desktopAutomation.monitorRunning: The recipe is running on this machine's desktop.
desktopAutomation.monitorDown: The live monitor is unavailable - the desktop agent may be off. The run continues either way.
desktopAutomation.saveRun: Save this run as a desktop recipe
desktopAutomation.saveRunTitle: Save this run as a desktop recipe
desktopAutomation.saveRunIntro: The desktop steps from this run are saved so they can be replayed later. Values you typed are never kept - list them below so they become parameters.
desktopAutomation.paramsTitle: Values you gave in this run
desktopAutomation.paramsHelp: For each value you supplied, name it. It is swapped for a placeholder and the value is discarded.
desktopAutomation.paramBadName: Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
desktopAutomation.paramDuplicate: Each parameter needs its own name.
desktopAutomation.allowLiteral: Keep any other typed text as written (only for fixed text that is not personal or secret)
desktopAutomation.saveWarnings: Check before you rely on it
desktopAutomation.monitorLiveRunning: Streaming the screen - you are watching the agent work in real time.
desktopAutomation.monitorPanelHint: You are watching the agent drive this machine in real time - each click and keystroke lands as you see it. Collapse to pause the stream.
desktopAutomation.screenDockPopOut: Pop out - keeps watching the agent while this tab is minimized
